title: Tau: a terminal coding agent built to be read, not just run
description:
Tau is a terminal coding agent you're actually meant to read, not just run, a working answer to "how is a coding agent even built?" Most agents are either a black-box CLI or a giant production repo you can't learn anything from. This splits into three small layers you can read alone: one turns any provider into a neutral event stream, one is the portable brain of tools and loop, one wraps it as a real coding app. #github #opensource 

https://github.com/huggingface/tau
